## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 3-fascicle text is [淨源](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B7%A8%E6%BA%90) Jìngyuán's substantial Northern-Sòng commentary on [宗密](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E5%AF%86) Zōngmì's *[Yuán rén lùn](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0105)* (T1886). The title — *fā wēi* 發微 "drawing out the subtleties" — signals the work's exegetical aim: to make the implicit doctrinal structures of Zōngmì's brief but doctrinally dense original text fully explicit for Sòng readers.

**Abstract**

The work is conventionally datable to [淨源](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B7%A8%E6%BA%90) Jìngyuán's mature period at the Huìyīnsì 慧因寺 in Hángzhōu, c. 1067 – 1088 CE; the bracket adopted here reflects this window. As one of Jìngyuán's substantial editorial-commentarial projects, the work is part of his broader Northern-Sòng programme to consolidate the Tang Huáyán-school doctrinal corpus.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1031) collection.
